title: Please Don’t Open the Wrong Window
simplified_paragraphs: 一个小女孩站在窗边，看窗外的人正埋葬他们可爱的小狗。小女孩看了难过得哭了起来。
她的爷爷看见了，马上把她带到了另一扇窗户旁边，让她看美丽的花园。花非常漂亮，果然小女孩看见花后，心情马上就变好了，她很快就高兴得笑了起来。爷爷对小女孩说："孩子，你开错了窗户。你看，换了一扇窗户，世界是不是就不一样了？”
遇到失败请不要难过，打开失败旁边的窗户，也许你就看到了希望。
traditional_paragraphs: 一個小女孩站在窗邊，看窗外的人正埋葬他們可愛的小狗。小女孩看了難過得哭了起來。
她的爺爺看見了，馬上把她帶到了另一扇窗戶旁邊，讓她看美麗的花園。花非常漂亮，果然小女孩看見花後，心情馬上就變好了，她很快就高興得笑了起來。爺爺對小女孩說："孩子，你開錯了窗戶。你看，換了一扇窗戶，世界是不是就不一樣了？”
遇到失敗請不要難過，打開失敗旁邊的窗戶，也許你就看到了希望。
pinyin_paragraphs: yī gè xiǎo nǚ hái zhàn zài chuāng biān， kàn chuāng wài de rén zhèng mái zàng tā men kě ài de xiǎo gǒu。 xiǎo nǚ hái kàn le nán guò de kū le qǐ lái。

tā de yé ye kàn jiàn le， mǎ shàng bǎ tā dài dào le lìng yī shàn chuāng hu páng biān， ràng tā kàn měi lì de huā yuán。 huā fēi cháng piào liang， guǒ rán xiǎo nǚ hái kàn jiàn huā hòu， xīn qíng mǎ shàng jiù biàn hǎo le， tā hěn kuài jiù gāo xìng de xiào le qǐ lái。 yé ye duì xiǎo nǚ hái shuō：" hái zi， nǐ kāi cuò le chuāng hu。 nǐ kàn， huàn le yī shàn chuāng hu， shì jiè shì bù shì jiù bù yī yàng le？”
yù dào shī bài qǐng bù yào nán guò， dǎ kāi shī bài páng biān de chuāng hu， yě xǔ nǐ jiù kàn dào le xī wàng。
english_paragraphs: A little girl stood by the window, watching people outside bury their beloved puppy. The sight made her so sad that she began to cry.

Her grandfather saw her and quickly led her to another window, where she could look out at a beautiful garden. The flowers were lovely, and sure enough, the little girl felt better as soon as she saw them. Before long, she was smiling happily. Her grandfather said, "You were looking out the wrong window, my child. See? When you look out a different window, doesn't the world seem different?"
When you face failure, don't be too sad. Open the window beside it, and perhaps you'll find hope.
english_full:
A little girl stood by the window, watching people outside bury their beloved puppy. The sight made her so sad that she began to cry.

Her grandfather saw her and quickly led her to another window, where she could look out at a beautiful garden. The flowers were lovely, and sure enough, the little girl felt better as soon as she saw them. Before long, she was smiling happily. Her grandfather said, "You were looking out the wrong window, my child. See? When you look out a different window, doesn't the world seem different?"

When you face failure, don't be too sad. Open the window beside it, and perhaps you'll find hope.
